description:
Activate Unctus by paying {U/P}, causing Emmara to become a blue artifact until end of turn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Emmara and another artifact, targeting Emmara.
Emmara triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Emmara.
Repeat from step 2.
